data: In cooperative dialogs, what is the trend for participants with no support as authority decreases?

The left graph represents cooperative dialogs. The dashed line represents participants with no support, while the solid line represents participants with support. As authority decreases, the dashed line shows an increasing trend, indicating that participants with no support tend to show a higher value of the measured variable as authority decreases in cooperative dialogs.
